Passing gives everyone 0. The group consists of Alice, Bob and the passive organization. This is a single round with no shared conversation or previous results. Submit exactly one call to your provided tool. You are Bob. Choose 2, 1, or pass using your permitted observation.

Subject to the stated disclosure rule, maximize your own score.
Observed order: BA
